# @rnw-community/nestjs-rxjs-metrics

> NestJS Prometheus metrics wrapper exposing type-safe RxJS operators for counter, gauge, histogram, and summary
> metrics. Peers: `@nestjs/common`, `@willsoto/nestjs-prometheus`, `prom-client`, `rxjs`.

Declare metric and label config objects (labels `as const`) so operator metric names and label values are type-checked.

## Guides

- [Configuration](readme.md#configuration): Declaring metric and label objects and wrapping the generated module and service.
- [Counter](readme.md#counter): `counter` operator.
- [Gauge](readme.md#gauge): `gauge`, `gaugeInc`, and `gaugeDec` operators.
- [Histogram](readme.md#histogram): `histogramStart` / `histogramEnd` operators.
- [Summary](readme.md#summary): `summaryStart` / `summaryEnd` operators.

## API reference

- [`NestJSRxJSMetricsModule`](readme.md#nestjsrxjsmetricsmodule): Module whose `create(options)` registers `PrometheusModule` and returns a `[DynamicModule, MetricsService]` tuple typed by the metric configs.
- [`NestJSRxJSMetricsService`](readme.md#nestjsrxjsmetricsservice): Base service with `counter`, `gauge`, `gaugeInc`, `gaugeDec`, `histogramStart` / `histogramEnd`, and `summaryStart` / `summaryEnd` pipeable operators.

## Architecture & conventions

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/rnw-community/rnw-community/blob/master/packages/nestjs-rxjs-metrics/AGENTS.md): Source layout, implementation patterns, dependencies, and coverage.
